issues.display_title: Issue #4076: Add Tutorial Link & Update Tooltip on "Map Rejected" Icon
issues.main_description_html:
Description

To better assist users when their image receives a "Map Rejected" status, we need to provide immediate, actionable help directly from the image grid UI.

Currently, hovering over the rejection indicator (the purple exclamation mark icon) only states the status. We need to update the tooltip text to encourage users to click, and make the icon clickable so it redirects them to a tutorial video on how to resolve the rejection.

Sub-tasks

  • Update Tooltip Text: Modify the existing hover tooltip on the purple exclamation mark icon.
    • New Text: "Map Rejected - Click to see how to fix" (or append the click instruction to the existing text).
  • Implement Click Action: Add an onClick event or wrap the icon in an anchor tag. Ensure the CSS cursor changes to pointer on hover so users know it is interactive.
  • External Redirect: Configure the click action to open the following YouTube tutorial video in a new browser tab (using target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer"):
    • Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iAS79cuZaWw

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Hovering over the purple rejection icon displays the newly updated tooltip text.
  2. The icon acts as a clickable button (shows a pointer cursor on hover).
  3. Clicking the icon successfully opens the correct YouTube video in a new browser tab without closing the current application state.

Test Scenario (for Tester / QA)

Preconditions

  • Logged in and viewing a tour whose 360 image grid contains at least one image with a "Map Rejected" status (purple exclamation mark icon on the thumbnail card).

Scenario 1 — Tooltip text

  1. Hover the cursor over the purple "!" rejection icon.
  2. ✅ Expected: Tooltip shows the updated text — "Map Rejected - Click to see how to fix" (or the existing status text with the click instruction appended).

Scenario 2 — Interactive cursor

  1. Hover over the purple "!" icon.
  2. ✅ Expected: The cursor changes to a pointer (hand), signalling the icon is clickable.

Scenario 3 — Click redirect (happy path)

  1. Click the purple "!" icon.
  2. ✅ Expected: A new browser tab opens to https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iAS79cuZaWw.
  3. ✅ Expected: The original GoThru tab/application state is unchanged (not navigated away, no reload, current page/selection preserved).

Scenario 4 — Security attributes

  1. Inspect the icon's link/handler (DevTools).
  2. ✅ Expected: Opens via target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" (new tab cannot access window.opener).

Scenario 5 — Regression / non-rejected images

  1. Hover/click on images that are not "Map Rejected" (e.g. green/approved status).
  2. ✅ Expected: No tutorial link or rejection tooltip appears; their behavior is unchanged.

Pass criteria: All scenarios behave as the ✅ Expected results; the YouTube link is correct and opens safely in a new tab without disrupting the app.

Reference: docs/superpowers/specs/analyze-all.md — see §2.2 / §4 (Tour editor & publishing status). The purple "!" icon appears on image thumbnail cards in the 360 image grid.

issues.display_title: Issue #4082: Add Status Toggle "Show Photographers Approved" to Featured Photographers Table
issues.main_description_html:
Description

To optimize the workflow for the Support team, we need to change the default view of the Featured Photographers page. Currently, the table loads all requests, causing it to be cluttered with already approved photographers.

New Logic

  • When a Support user enters the page, the table should only display "Pending" and "Denied" requests by default.
  • To view the approved ones, add a toggle switch above the table labeled "Show photographer approved".
  • The default state of this toggle is false.

Sub-tasks

  • Default State Logic: Update the initial data fetch/render logic on page load so that it filters out "Approved" requests. The table should only show items with a "Pending" or "Denied" status.
  • Add Toggle UI: Implement a toggle switch above the table with the label "Show photographer approved".
  • Toggle Action: Set the default value of the toggle to false. When the user toggles it to true, update the table state to include "Approved" photographers in the list.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. On page load, the Featured Photographers table shows only Pending and Denied requests (Approved are hidden by default).
  2. A "Show photographer approved" toggle is visible above the table and defaults to off (false).
  3. Toggling it on (true) includes Approved photographers in the table; toggling off hides them again — without a full page reload.

Reference: docs/superpowers/specs/analyze-all.md — see §3 Persona D (Support/Admin) and §4 (Support / admin tooling: featured photographers).

issues.display_title: Issue #4083: Implement Clarify Free AI Tokens Conversion in AI Blur Modal
issues.main_description_html:
Description

A UX issue was reported where users (specifically new users) can successfully apply AI Blur even when their account appears to have 0 standard tokens. The system grants free AI tokens, but that balance is hidden, and the Order Summary modal silently folds it into the deduction — showing a confusing "Total Cost: 0 Tokens" with no indication of which tokens (free vs. paid) were consumed.

This task makes the Free AI Token balance visible and breaks the deduction down so the billing math is clear.

📐 Based on approved design: docs/brains/2026-06-17-ai-blur-free-token-balance-design.md (Status: Approved).
⚠️ Note: The design sets the conversion as 1 paid Token = 10 AI Tokens (the original ticket said "20"). The design value is authoritative.

Affected File

  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Blur/Components/AIBlurModal.jsx

The API already returns v1CreditData.free_trial (the free AI token balance), but it is currently folded into effectiveCreditAvailable without being surfaced to the user.

Design Overview

New computed values (added after savedForLater, ~line 91)

  • freeCreditsAvailable — free AI tokens from v1CreditData.free_trial (only for isAllowedUser; else 0).
  • freeCreditsApplied — min(freeCreditsAvailable, blurringCost).
  • paidCreditsApplied — paid subscription credits consumed after free credits run out.

No changes to existing values (blurringCost, effectiveCreditAvailable, totalCost, tokenRequired, savedForLater).

Order Summary UI changes

  1. New "Free AI Tokens" balance row (only when isAllowedUser), inserted before the Blurring Cost row:
    • Chip is green with a gift icon (fa-gift) when freeCreditsAvailable > 0.
    • Chip is muted grey with a ban icon (fa-ban) when freeCreditsAvailable === 0.
    • ℹ️ tooltip text: "Free AI Tokens are given at no cost and are used first before your paid Tokens. 1 paid Token = 10 AI Tokens."
  2. Replace the "Available AI Tokens Used" row with conditional indented sub-rows for allowed users:
    • "Free Tokens Applied" (green, fa-gift) when freeCreditsApplied > 0.
    • "Paid Credits Applied" (amber, fa-coins) when paidCreditsApplied > 0.
    • Non-allowed users keep the original single row unchanged.

Behavior by scenario

Scenario Free AI Tokens chip Sub-rows shown
1 — All free (free covers full cost) 🟢 green, balance > 0 "Free Tokens Applied" only
2 — Mixed (free exhausted, subscription fills rest) 🟢 green, balance > 0 "Free Tokens Applied" → "Paid Credits Applied"
3 — No free (0 free tokens) ⬜ muted grey, balance = 0 Neither sub-row shown

i18n

Add four keys under t_panorama_tools.t_ai_blur.t_modal to all 18 locale files (ba, cs, da, de, en, es, fr, hi, it, jp, nl, pl, pt, ro, ru, sk, sv, zh); en.json is authoritative, others receive the English string until translated:

  • t_free_tokens_available → "Free AI Tokens"
  • t_free_tokens_available_tooltip → "Free AI Tokens are given at no cost and are used first before your paid Tokens. 1 paid Token = 10 AI Tokens."
  • t_free_tokens_applied → "Free Tokens Applied"
  • t_paid_credits_applied → "Paid Credits Applied"

Acceptance Criteria

  1. When isAllowedUser is true, a "Free AI Tokens" row appears above "Blurring Cost" in the order summary.
  2. When freeCreditsAvailable > 0, the chip is green with a gift icon (fa-gift).
  3. When freeCreditsAvailable === 0, the chip is muted grey with a ban icon (fa-ban).
  4. The ℹ️ tooltip reads: "Free AI Tokens are given at no cost and are used first before your paid Tokens. 1 paid Token = 10 AI Tokens."
  5. When free credits cover the full cost: only the "Free Tokens Applied" sub-row appears (green, indented).
  6. When cost exceeds the free balance and subscription credits fill the rest: both "Free Tokens Applied" (green) and "Paid Credits Applied" (amber) sub-rows appear.
  7. When freeCreditsAvailable === 0: neither sub-row appears.
  8. Non-allowed users see the original "Available AI Tokens Used" row unchanged.
  9. All 18 locale files have the four new i18n keys added.
  10. Dark mode is supported for all new elements (green/amber tonal variants).

Out of Scope

  • Changing how tokens are consumed or the order of credit deduction.
  • Showing the free token balance anywhere outside this modal.
  • Translating the four new keys into non-English locales.
  • Changes to isNoToken / isHasToken / isUnsubscribe state logic.

Reference: docs/brains/2026-06-17-ai-blur-free-token-balance-design.md (approved design) and docs/superpowers/specs/analyze-all.md §5.2 (Token micropayments). Related to blur work #4072–#4075.

Backend Status Code & Review

Flow: Tour Detail -> Blur -> Blur.jsx -> AIBlurModal.jsx -> backend GET /tours/ai-remaining-credit?type=blur and GET /users/tokens

Backend result HTTP/body status Frontend outcome Review

AI remaining credit GET /tours/ai-remaining-credit?type=blur returned HTTP 200 Credit response was consumed by modal, but Free AI Tokens balance row was not surfaced Bug

UI conversion display Source and real UI still use/show 20 AI Tokens conversion Tooltip displayed 1 token = 20 AI Tokens, conflicting with approved 10 Bug

Code Review Summary

  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Blur/Components/AIBlurModal.jsx:8 still defines CREDITS_PER_TOKEN = 20, conflicting with the issue's authoritative design value 1 paid Token = 10 AI Tokens.
  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Blur/Components/AIBlurModal.jsx:69 comment says 1 token = 10 credits, but the computation still divides by CREDITS_PER_TOKEN = 20, so code and UI are internally inconsistent.
  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Blur/Components/AIBlurModal.jsx:268 renders the Free AI Tokens balance row only when freeCreditsAvailable > 0; therefore the required zero-balance muted grey fa-ban row cannot render.
  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Blur/Components/AIBlurModal.jsx does not receive or branch on an explicit isAllowedUser, so the required allowed-user vs non-allowed-user behavior is not clearly preserved.
  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Blur/Blur.jsx passes creditAvailable, isBasicOrPayAsYouGo, and tokenTotal into AIBlurModal, but does not pass an isAllowedUser prop matching the acceptance language.
  • All 18 locale files contain the four new i18n keys, but t_free_tokens_available_tooltip still says 1 paid Token = 20 AI Tokens instead of 10 AI Tokens.

Confusion Matrix

Actual / Expected Expected Pass Expected Fail
Actual Pass 2 - locale keys exist in all 18 files; no production mutation occurred 0
Actual Fail 5 - conversion constant, tooltip conversion, Free AI Tokens row, zero-balance chip, allowed-user branch 0

Evidence

  • Screenshot(s): uploaded below.
  • Video: uploaded below; automated real production run with browser address bar visible on monitor 2 left.
  • Manual video review: C:\Users\Work\Videos\2026-07-17 11-42-46.mp4; confirms the same production behavior at app.gothru.co/my-tours/3550977/blur.
  • Logs/API notes:
    • Static command: node qa_testing\node_modules\@playwright\test\cli.js test --config=qa_testing\playwright.config.js --project=user --grep "#4083" --reporter=line
    • Static result: 1 passed, 1 failed; failure is Expected substring: "const CREDITS_PER_TOKEN = 10" but source contains const CREDITS_PER_TOKEN = 20.
    • Real-data recorder: node qa_testing\scripts\record-issue-4083-real-data.cjs
    • Real-data result: selected MID 3550977, modal opened, mutationAttempted=false.
    • Real modal text included Remaining AI Tokens 18 AI Tokens, Blurring Cost 1 AI Tokens, Paid Credits Applied -1 AI Tokens, Total Cost 0 AI Tokens, and no Free AI Tokens row.

Bug Notes

  • This is a product/source bug, not a setup issue. The production UI, source constant, and locale tooltip copy all disagree with the issue's approved design value.
  • Critical user-facing impact: users still cannot tell that free AI tokens exist or are consumed first, and the modal communicates the wrong conversion rate.
  • Recommended fix: change conversion constant and tooltip copy to 10, render Free AI Tokens for allowed users even when balance is zero, and add/confirm the isAllowedUser branch so non-allowed users keep the original Available AI Tokens Used row.
